aim: Explain repeatable marking expression using an open number of classes and independently evaluate new composition outcomes.
fit_inventory: ordinary non-OOS personal-comparison expression records with peer_n >= 3; preserve historical exclusions as behavior only; special_conditional quality domain is not ordinary quality validation
normalization: same image, condition, layer and reference peer median; equal buildings per worker
conditional_opportunity: same panel median noncollinear turn count >= 6; geometry opportunity only, not a semantic truth or correctness label
candidate_selection: nested held-building reconstruction of actual expression; inner building left out before worker histories, scaling, clustering and class centroids; outer building absent from all selection
coarse_fine: one Ward tree for a chosen feature family; fine cut minimizes inner loss, coarse is simplest supported ancestor within paired one-standard-error of the fine cut
unknown: missing opportunity retained as missing, not zero
evaluation_status: new classifiers and new member/background panels on a repeatedly studied repository; not new external blind data
